vehicles.name: Nissan Rogue
vehicles.summary: Five seats in two rows. A compact SUV to consider for daily driving when you do not need a third row.
vehicles.tradeoff: Cannot seat six or seven passengers; move to a three-row model for a larger family.

vehicles.name: Volkswagen Atlas
vehicles.summary: Three rows, with seating up to seven. Start here if carrying more than five people is your main requirement.
vehicles.tradeoff: Choose the seven-seat configuration if you need seven places; captain's chairs reduce capacity. Atlas Cross Sport is a different, two-row model.

vehicles.name: Volvo XC90
vehicles.summary: Three rows with six- or seven-seat configurations. Consider it alongside Atlas when you want a luxury family SUV.
vehicles.tradeoff: Verify the seating configuration. This guide covers the mild hybrid; the plug-in hybrid and electric EX90 are separate variants.

vehicles.name: Nissan Pathfinder
vehicles.summary: A three-row SUV with seating up to eight. Add it to your shortlist when you regularly carry a larger group.
vehicles.tradeoff: Seven-seat captain's-chair and eight-seat configurations differ. Try your passengers and luggage together before deciding.

vehicles.name: Audi Q5
vehicles.summary: A two-row luxury SUV with standard quattro all-wheel drive and a 14.5-inch MMI display in the 2026 guide.
vehicles.tradeoff: A five-seat SUV; choose a three-row vehicle if six or seven passengers are required.

vehicles.name: Mercedes-Benz GLC 300 SUV
vehicles.summary: Five seats in a two-row luxury SUV. The GLC 300 uses a turbocharged engine with mild hybrid assistance.
vehicles.tradeoff: The GLC 350e is a separate plug-in hybrid. GLC 300 does not meet a seven-seat requirement.

vehicles.name: Porsche 911 Carrera 4S
vehicles.summary: Explore 77 selectable components in our 2026 systems reconstruction: rotate, explode, inspect the engine and drivetrain, or connect an official recall notice to its representative region.
vehicles.tradeoff: Original component shapes and positions are illustrative. This is not a dealer VIN or stock listing. A separately credited exterior reference is also available in the explorer.
